title: Bind each journey spec to a train or journey declared under plan/

facts.note: Scope gate: rule applies only when the repository declares at least one train or journey under plan/.
Candidate browser specs by filename; filename alone is not sufficient, see next fact.
Needs an observer resolving the Playwright test selection (config testMatch/testDir) so non-Playwright *.e2e.ts files do not activate.

values: test file whose header comments carry a journey marker (// Train:, // Journey:, // URN: test:train:…, // URN: test:journey:…)
facts.note: Independent route: header-comment marker scan so misnamed browser specs are still judged; a URN mentioned in a string literal does not count.

values: binding id does not resolve to a declared train/journey under plan/
facts.note: Produced by htmx_e2e_detector resolving each spec's header id against plan/; applies to all browser specs in the repository, existing or new.

values: bound declared subject is not the subject the spec walks
facts.note: Semantic check used by prefer/avoid when choosing the id; primary obligation belongs to the suggested split rule.

fires: plan/ declares trains/journeys and an existing Playwright *.e2e.ts spec's header binds to an id with no declaration under plan/.
A test file not named *.e2e.ts whose `// Journey:` header names an undeclared journey.
A Playwright spec has no binding, two bindings, or an id the planner would reject.
A spec's binding resolves to a declared subject but not the one its browser path walks (prefer/avoid apply; obligation owned by the split rule tester.htmx.e2e-binding-matches-walked-subject).
doesNotFire: The repository has no plan (no trains, no journeys).
Files under node_modules, dist, build or _generated.
A unit test that merely mentions a journey URN inside a string.
A *.e2e.ts file not run by Playwright and with no journey marker header.
A malformed binding header (reported by tester.htmx.journey-binding-header instead).

given: plan/ declares at least one train or journey, and a browser spec exists (a *.e2e.ts file run by Playwright, or a test file with a journey marker header)
when: the spec's binding is checked against plan/
then: The train or journey the spec binds to MUST be declared under plan/.
prefer: Bind to the declared subject the spec actually exercises: find the plan subject reached by its entrypoint and interactions; use that exact declared id in the header.
If the intended subject is absent from the plan, return to the authorized planning flow instead of inventing it in the tester repair.
avoid: Choosing any resolvable declared subject merely to clear the finding (false journey coverage).
Changing the binding to match a convenient test that proves another journey.
Declaring a new train or journey solely so an existing spec has something to bind.
unless: No plan (no trains, no journeys): out of scope.
node_modules, dist, build, _generated are never scanned.
why: The binding traces a browser test to the plan it exercises; no binding, two bindings, or an id the planner would reject is untraceable. Resolution is necessary but not sufficient: the subject must be the one walked, and plan changes only when product behavior requires it.
evidence: The binding id in the spec header resolves to a train or journey declared under plan/.
The browser path actually walks the bound subject.
The final observable assertion proves that subject's user-facing behavior.
plan/ was not changed only to give the spec something to bind.
verifier_detail: browser_spec = a *.e2e.ts file run by Playwright, or any test file whose header comments carry a journey marker (`// Train:`, `// Journey:`, `// URN: test:train:…`, `// URN: test:journey:…`), so a misnamed one is still judged. A unit test that merely mentions a journey URN in a string is not one.
Report specs with no binding, two bindings, or an id the planner would reject as untraceable.
Skip node_modules, dist, build, _generated; skip entirely when no trains and no journeys are declared; leave malformed headers to tester.htmx.journey-binding-header.
Severity 3, disposition strict. Implemented by validator htmx_e2e_detector.
audit: Bun/htmx realization of tester.vite.e2e-names-valid-train (metadata.mirrors), strict; extended to journeys.
Original name/summary: 'A journey spec binds to a train or journey plan/ declares'.
Source statement: 'When the repository declares a plan, the train or journey a journey spec binds to MUST be declared under plan/.'

splitSuggestion.then: The declared train or journey a browser spec binds to MUST be the subject its browser path actually walks and its final observable assertion proves.
A train or journey MUST NOT be declared under plan/ solely to give an already-written spec something to bind; plan changes only when product behavior requires the subject.

additions.text: then is restricted to resolution; walked-subject correctness (S014) and not-rescuing-via-plan (S016) are separate obligations, proposed as tester.htmx.e2e-binding-matches-walked-subject and tester.htmx.plan-not-changed-to-rescue-spec. Their content remains here in prefer/avoid/why/evidence because it governs how this rule's finding is repaired.
additions.justification: Rule 2: one obligation per then; source says resolution is necessary but not sufficient.

additions.text: plan/ was not changed only to give the spec something to bind.
additions.justification: Makes the S016/S024 anti-pattern verifiable by reviewers.

additions.justification: Source qualifies *.e2e.ts by 'run by Playwright'; filename alone cannot establish this.
